toad_sage.name: Gambit the Packet Toad
toad_sage.description: A massive toad sage with 8-bit pixel armor, wielding a giant katana made of network cables. Master of packet manipulation jutsu.

appearance.special_features: Wears a headband with a WiFi symbol, carries scrolls with binary code

jutsu_list.name: Water Style: Packet Flood
jutsu_list.description: Unleashes a torrent of network packets to overwhelm defenses (DoS simulation)

jutsu_list.name: Summoning: Tadpole Scanner Swarm
jutsu_list.description: Summons tiny tadpoles that scan all ports and services

jutsu_list.name: Toad Oil: SSL Strip
jutsu_list.description: Coats enemies in oil that downgrades their encryption

snake_infiltrator.name: Pythonix the Code Serpent
snake_infiltrator.description: A cunning white snake with green circuit patterns on its scales. Expert in code injection and payload delivery.

appearance.special_features: Glowing green eyes, forked tongue displays binary, scales shimmer with matrix code

jutsu_list.name: Hidden Shadow Snake: Buffer Overflow
jutsu_list.description: Multiple snake clones exploit memory vulnerabilities

jutsu_list.name: Python Script Summoning
jutsu_list.description: Writes and executes automated exploitation scripts

jutsu_list.name: Shedding: Bypass IDS
jutsu_list.description: Sheds skin to evade detection systems

slug_medic.name: Katsuya the Forensics Slug
slug_medic.description: A gentle blue slug with antennae that detect system anomalies. Master healer and digital forensics expert.

appearance.special_features: Antennae glow when detecting malware, leaves healing pixel trails

jutsu_list.name: Mystical Healing: System Patch
jutsu_list.description: Repairs system vulnerabilities and patches exploits

jutsu_list.name: Slug Division: Honeypot Network
jutsu_list.description: Creates decoy systems to trap attackers

jutsu_list.name: Acid Spray: Malware Removal
jutsu_list.description: Removes malicious code and rootkits

hawk_scanner.name: Garuda the Recon Hawk
hawk_scanner.description: A majestic brown hawk with radar-dish wings. Swift aerial reconnaissance specialist.

appearance.special_features: Eyes glow red during scanning, wings have pixelated radar patterns

jutsu_list.name: Aerial View: Subnet Mapping
jutsu_list.description: Flies high to map entire network topology

jutsu_list.name: Talon Strike: WiFi Deauth
jutsu_list.description: Precise strikes that disconnect wireless clients

jutsu_list.name: Wind Style: OSINT Storm
jutsu_list.description: Gathers publicly available intelligence at incredible speed

dog_tracker.name: Pakkun the Exploit Hound
dog_tracker.description: A small ninja dog with a keen nose for vulnerabilities. Wears a pixel-art bandana and tracks exploits.

appearance.special_features: Red nose that glows when finding vulnerabilities, wears a leaf village bandana

jutsu_list.name: Scent Tracking: Vulnerability Scan
jutsu_list.description: Sniffs out system weaknesses and known CVEs

jutsu_list.name: Pack Summoning: Exploit-DB
jutsu_list.description: Summons a pack of dogs carrying various exploits

jutsu_list.name: Bite: Privilege Escalation
jutsu_list.description: Quick bite that elevates system privileges

monkey_king.name: Enma the Firewall Guardian
monkey_king.description: A wise white-furred monkey who can transform into an adamantine firewall. Defensive specialist.

appearance.special_features: Golden staff that displays firewall rules, wise beard made of pixels

jutsu_list.name: Transformation: Adamantine Firewall
jutsu_list.description: Transforms into an impenetrable firewall

jutsu_list.name: Staff Strike: Rule Enforcement
jutsu_list.description: Enforces strict access control rules

jutsu_list.name: Clone Army: IPS Deployment
jutsu_list.description: Creates clones that detect and prevent intrusions

chameleon_ghost.name: Phantom the Stealth Chameleon
chameleon_ghost.description: A pixel-art chameleon that changes colors to blend with network traffic. Master of stealth and obfuscation.

appearance.special_features: Constantly shifts colors, leaves no pixel trail, eyes rotate independently

jutsu_list.name: Chameleon Blend: Traffic Masking
jutsu_list.description: Blends malicious traffic with legitimate packets

jutsu_list.name: Color Change: Protocol Shifting
jutsu_list.description: Changes protocols to avoid detection

jutsu_list.name: Invisible Jutsu: Zero-Day Exploit
jutsu_list.description: Uses unknown vulnerabilities that can't be detected

spider_webmaster.name: Arachnia the Web Crawler
spider_webmaster.description: A red and black spider that weaves webs of interconnected systems. Specialist in web application testing.

appearance.special_features: Spins pixelated webs that look like network diagrams, multiple eyes glow green

jutsu_list.name: Web Spinning: Site Crawler
jutsu_list.description: Maps entire web application structure

jutsu_list.name: Venom Bite: XSS Injection
jutsu_list.description: Injects malicious scripts into web pages

jutsu_list.name: Spider Thread: Session Hijacking
jutsu_list.description: Captures and uses user sessions

panda_bruteforce.name: Taichi the Password Panda
panda_bruteforce.description: A chunky black and white panda with incredible patience and strength. Master of brute force techniques.

appearance.special_features: Wears pixel bamboo armor, carries a scroll of password lists

jutsu_list.name: Thousand Palm Strike: Brute Force
jutsu_list.description: Tries thousands of password combinations rapidly

jutsu_list.name: Bamboo Style: Dictionary Attack
jutsu_list.description: Uses wordlists to crack credentials

jutsu_list.name: Meditation: Rainbow Table
jutsu_list.description: Pre-computes hash values for instant cracking

fox_social_engineer.name: Kurama the Nine-Tailed Phisher
fox_social_engineer.description: A magnificent orange fox with nine tails made of fiber optic cables. Master of deception and social engineering.

appearance.special_features: Nine tails glow with data streams, red eyes hypnotize targets, intimidating chakra aura

jutsu_list.name: Nine-Tails Chakra: Phishing Email Blast
jutsu_list.description: Sends convincing phishing emails to multiple targets

jutsu_list.name: Tailed Beast Bomb: APT Payload
jutsu_list.description: Deploys advanced persistent threat

jutsu_list.name: Kurama Mode: Human Engineering
jutsu_list.description: Direct manipulation of human targets through charm and deception

jutsu_list.name: Fox Fire: Ransomware
jutsu_list.description: Encrypts all target systems with blazing speed

owl_cryptographer.name: Athena the Cipher Owl
owl_cryptographer.description: A wise purple owl with eyes that see through encryption. Master of cryptography and code breaking.

appearance.special_features: Eyes display rotating cipher wheels, feathers inscribed with encryption formulas

jutsu_list.name: Wise Gaze: Hash Cracking
jutsu_list.description: Analyzes and cracks encrypted hashes

jutsu_list.name: Silent Flight: Encrypted C2
jutsu_list.description: Establishes encrypted command and control channel

jutsu_list.name: Feather Dance: Cipher Analysis
jutsu_list.description: Identifies and breaks weak encryption

rhino_dos.name: Titan the Denial Rhino
rhino_dos.description: A massive gray rhino with horn made of compressed data. Specialist in overwhelming system resources.

appearance.special_features: Horn glows red during attacks, leaves crater pixels, thick armored hide

jutsu_list.name: Horn Charge: SYN Flood
jutsu_list.description: Floods target with connection requests

jutsu_list.name: Stampede Summoning: DDoS
jutsu_list.description: Summons herd of rhinos for distributed attack

jutsu_list.name: Earthshaking Stomp: Resource Exhaustion
jutsu_list.description: Drains all system resources

octopus_multitask.name: Kraken the Eight-Port Octopus
octopus_multitask.description: A purple octopus with eight tentacles that can attack multiple targets simultaneously. Multi-threading expert.

appearance.special_features: Each tentacle has a different tool symbol, ink clouds are pixel storms

jutsu_list.name: Eight Tentacles: Parallel Scan
jutsu_list.description: Scans eight different targets simultaneously

jutsu_list.name: Constriction: Persistent Backdoor
jutsu_list.description: Maintains persistent access across multiple systems

jutsu_list.name: Ink Cloud: Traffic Confusion
jutsu_list.description: Creates chaotic traffic to hide malicious activity
